addr: 2727/1, 16th Cross, 27th Main Rd, HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: Had a great experience at Olive Street Café, HSR. We tried the Wok 'N' Chick Rice Bowl, Chikku Go Wild Milkshake, Chunky Paneer Roll, Grilled Lays Paratha Roll, Mix Lays Paratha Roll, Chicken Jumbo Melt Roll, and Nuto KitKat Milkshake. …

Very good place and an affordable option to explore the chicken and bread varieties.
Thier mayo was very tasty. Would definitely worth twice a visit in a single week …

Olive Street Food in HSR Layout is one of those rare gems where the name might lead you to expect a basic roadside stall, but the reality is a surprisingly well-managed and aesthetic cafe. Even though the prices are incredibly affordable …
